sql.membership: SELECT l.id,l.lineIndex,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM line_toc other WHERE other.lineId=l.id) FROM line l JOIN line_toc lt ON lt.lineId=l.id WHERE l.bookId=? AND lt.tocEntryId=? ORDER BY l.lineIndex
sql.preceding: SELECT MIN(l.lineIndex) FROM line l JOIN line_toc lt ON lt.lineId=l.id JOIN tocEntry t ON t.id=lt.tocEntryId AND t.bookId=l.bookId WHERE l.bookId=? AND t.parentId=? AND t.id<>?
sql.selected: SELECT l.id,t.id,t.parentId,t.level FROM line l JOIN line_toc lt ON lt.lineId=l.id JOIN tocEntry t ON t.id=lt.tocEntryId AND t.bookId=l.bookId WHERE l.bookId=? AND l.lineIndex=? ORDER BY t.level DESC,t.id
